brief:
The United States conducted an extrajudicial killing of two individuals in a boat strike, according to Drop Site News. The operation's precise timing, location, and stated justification remain unclear from available reporting. Extrajudicial strikes by U.S. forces have drawn criticism from human rights organizations over transparency and adherence to international law.

In Haiti, a gang raid killed 47 people, underscoring the escalating toll of armed group violence in the country. The incident reflects ongoing gang activity and territorial conflicts affecting civilian populations. Separately, Israeli forces seized a United Nations Relief and Works Agency center located in Jerusalem, marking another development in the contested city.
title: U.S. kills two in extrajudicial boat strike off Somalia
